text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Vietnamese press on Friday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
-- Iran bought more than 380,000 tonnes of rice from Vietnam last year and will buy more this year.
-- New two-year domestic treasury notes are being issued to attract individual investors.
-- Elections for Vietnam's National Assembly will be held on July 20
-- Preliminary plans are being formulated for an East-West highway linking Thailand, Laos and Vietnam.
-- The Agriculture and Rural Development Ministry has asked northern provinces to take more effective measures to protect paddy during cold weather.
-- The Hanoi city authorities have held a meeting to celebrate the 90th birthday of the late Communist Party General Secretary Truong Chinh.
-- Hanoi's People's Committee has called for stronger Party leadership and help with improving the city's health care system.
-- A new campaign has been launched to tackle illegal construction along the Red River dyke which protects Hanoi from flooding.
-- Argentina's ambassador to Hanoi has said his country is examining the prospects for cooperation with Vietnam in the fields of energy, infrastructure, agriculture, education and soccer.
-- 1.2 million new jobs were created throughout the country in 1996.
